title: Chapter 690 - 690 Heavenly Wind World; Opening!
content:
Chapter 690 - 690 Heavenly Wind World; Opening!

Chapter 690 - 690 Heavenly Wind World; Opening!

690 Heavenly Wind World; Opening!

Today, Qin Dachuan drank in the restaurant until late at night before he staggered back home.

When he was in Hong Planet, Qin Dachuan had always been suppressed by Ma Zheng.

He had never felt so carefree as now.

Whenever Qin Dachuan recalled Ma Zheng’s aggrieved look, he could not help but want to laugh out loud.

He lay on the bed and fell into a deep sleep.

He started dreaming.

Qin Dachuan was walking in a gloomy forest.

In the next moment, a malevolent hand bone suddenly drilled out of the ground and grabbed Qin Dachuan’s calf, scaring Qin Dachuan into retreating.

Soon after, the entire ground was densely packed with countless hand bones.

It was a terrifying sea of bones!

Qin Dachuan kept struggling in the sea of bones, but he was unable to break free.

Gradually, his entire body was devoured by the sea of bones, and he suffered terrible pain.

Qin Dachuan suddenly woke up from his dream. His entire body was covered in sweat as he panted heavily.

“So it was a dream…”

After drinking a whole bottle of water, he lay on the bed and fell asleep again.

This time, he did not dream of skeletons, but he dreamed of being tied up and eaten alive by savages.

Qin Dachuan woke up from his dream again.

“It’s so scary!

“Why do I keep having nightmares?!”

This situation lasted for several days.

Qin Dachuan became extremely dispirited, and his eyes were bloodshot.

Now, he did not dare to sleep anymore.

Once he fell asleep, he would enter a nightmare.

Even taking medicine was useless.

Fortunately, Qin Dachuan was a powerful cultivator.

Otherwise, he would probably have a mental breakdown long ago.

…

[Ding! Your enemy, Qin Dachuan, is mentally deranged because of your curse.]

Lin Fan smiled.

Curse was a pretty good skill.

Lin Fan found Ma Zheng and said, “Do you know where I can cultivate?”

Ma Zheng thought for a moment and said, “There’s a cultivation room in the Hundred Feet Building. It has dense spiritual energy inside.

“In addition, the materials of each cultivation room are very special. They have extremely strong defensive and soundproof effects. They can ensure safety and avoid disturbances as much as possible.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright.”

Not long after, Lin Fan arrived at the Hundred Feet Building. After paying ten spirit crystals, he went straight into a cultivation room that was about 100 square meters.

The layout of the cultivation room was very simple.

There was a cushion and a clear spring.

Lin Fan sat down cross-legged and unsealed the Flame Crystal according to the method taught by the system.

The temperature soared!

The entire cultivation room instantly turned fiery red.

Lin Fan felt around and realized that there were no signs of fire or damage.

He could not help but nod his head and say, “As expected of a cultivation ground. The materials in this space are indeed special.”

Then, he closed his eyes and silently absorbed the power of fire on the Flame Crystal.

Pure fire element… At first, it was like stars that flew into Lin Fan’s body.

Then, they turned into a tornado that entered Lin Fan’s body.

As more and more fire elements were absorbed by Lin Fan, his skin started to turn fiery red as well. He was like a Fire God that had descended into the world!

After an unknown period of time…

The energy was exhausted and shattered.

The size of the Flame Crystal kept decreasing.

In the end, it completely disappeared.

Lin Fan’s skin and the temperature of the cultivation room also gradually returned to normal.

Finally, Lin Fan opened his eyes.

At the same time, a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Fire Element Law upgraded to intermediate.]

Lin Fan could feel the fire power surging within his body, and a satisfied look appeared on his face.

Then, he slowly took a step forward and walked out.

Lin Fan had just arrived outside when he saw Ma Zheng waiting anxiously at the door.

When Ma Zheng saw Lin Fan, he hurriedly walked over and said excitedly, “Senior Lin, you’re out.”

Lin Fan nodded. “What’s the matter?”

“The Heavenly Wind World is about to open,” Ma Zheng said.

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but reveal an awkward look.

After all, Ma Zheng was very concerned about this trip to the Heavenly Wind World.

If he missed the time to enter because of him, he would really feel bad.

“Let’s go,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright, Senior Lin,” Ma Zheng said.

…

At this moment, a large square was filled with flying devices.

Groups of men and women with powerful auras were chatting in low voices with serious expressions. Some were filled with anticipation… All of them looked at a towering stone wall in the east.

That was because that was one of the places in the Heavenly Wind World.

An aircraft landed in a hurry.

Lin Fan and Ma Zheng walked down.

“Thank goodness we made it,” Ma Zheng Zhang said with a sigh of relief.

Lin Fan glanced around and said, “There are so many people here.”

“That’s right,” Ma Zheng said. “After all, the Heavenly Wind World only opens once every 10,000 years. Moreover, there are too many opportunities inside. No one wants to miss this chance.

“I heard that someone ate a fruit inside and became a Star Lord!

“Someone picked up an invincible technique, and in a short few thousand years, he became a Universe-level overlord!

“Someone else obtained an incomparably terrifying weapon!

“One person even picked up a storage ring. There was actually a Star Lord expert living inside!”

…

The more Ma Zheng spoke, the more excited he became. It was as if he would also obtain these treasures if he entered the Heavenly Wind World.

When Lin Fan heard that, a weird look appeared on his face.

An old man lived in the ring?

At this moment, an ear-piercing sound came from behind.

“Are you two going in too?” Qin Dachuan said.

“It’s none of your business whether we go in or not.” Ma Zheng frowned.

Qin Dachuan grinned and said, “Yes, it’s unrelated now, but that might not be the case once we enter! Fighting and killing are not prohibited inside!”

His threat was obvious!

After saying that, he walked into the distance arrogantly and bowed to a man in a black robe. “Greetings, Senior Liu.”

When Ma Zheng saw this, his expression immediately turned ugly.

“Senior Lin, I’m afraid we’re in trouble this time,” he said in a low voice. “It seems that Qin Dachuan will be entering the Heavenly Wind World with a high-level Planet martial artist.”

Lin Fan nodded his head noncommittally. However, his mind was focused on the system.

[Qin Dachuan. Hatred points: Two stars. Your curse caused him mental disorder, but he was later cured by a strong person.]

Lin Fan thought, ‘No wonder he doesn’t seem to be affected.’

At this moment, a vast aura rippled over.

Then, the ordinary-looking stone wall in the east emitted a dazzling light, like a scorching sun that had fallen on the ground. It illuminated the entire world.

The Heavenly Wind World was opened!
